description: You are standing at the northwest corner of the Landing.  The path, which bends to the northeast as it moves along this section of the western wall of the fortified trading post.  To the west can be seen a dark forest while to the south can be seen a rolling plain of high grasses.

title: [Wehnimer's, Outside Gate]
description: Citizens, merchants and assorted dregs of society jostle against you before the great wooden gates of Wehnimer's Landing.  Harried guards and militiamen try to keep the chaos to a minimum, but it is hard to keep track of those entering, let alone leaving, this large trading post.  A dirt path encircling the wooden palisade of the town leads east and southwest.  Nailed prominently to the wooden wall beside the gate is a sign you really should read.

description: Dockworkers curse you and each other as they carry their loads from the great trade ships to the warehouses of Wehnimer's Landing.  Intermixed with the dockworkers are the crews of ships from various exotic and faraway ports.

title: [Wehnimer's, Locksmehr Way]
description: To the east a dock spears out into the waters of the bay.  Ships from all across the world can be seen tied to the dock, and sailors of many races from many lands pass by.  To one side of the road stands a weathered and grey clapboard warehouse.

title: [Wehnimer's, Middle Dock]
description: Laboring dockworkers and strolling seamen mingle here on the weathered planks of the dock, between the hulls of large seafaring merchantmen.  The groan of ships pulling at hawsers, the clatter of feet upon gangplanks, and the swearing of the dockworkers mix with the cries of seabirds and the cadence of waves against the pilings.

title: [Wehnimer's, West Crossing]
description: From here, the vista along the horizon affords a view of both banks of the river.  To the west, the dark expanse of the town's low skyline is dominated by rambling structures and a few towers.  To the east lies the bridge across the Locksmehr, spanning the dark waters to the less-populated east bank.

title: [Wehnimer's, Bridge]
description: The heavy wood-planked bridge is old, but stands steady against the deep, dark river waters on massive stone pilings below.  Rope railings attached to weathered wooden posts are the only guard against a cold plunge in the Locksmehr, but the span is wide enough to bear the traffic without mishap.  The shadowy profiles of wooden buildings dot the east bank, and to the west lies the more heavily populated main part of town.

description: You are standing face-to-face with the southern wall of the Warrior Guild.  More fortress than building, its stone walls are interspersed with towering spires, the highest and most impressive being the two on the wall facing you. The entrance to the Guild itself is guarded by a massive portcullis of stout iron bars faced overall with mein reinforcing.

title: [Town Square, Northeast]
description: The entrance to Tykel's Arms, its heavy door bounded by iron-barred windows, dominates this corner of the square.  All manner of citizens pass by, moving among the solid, multistoried wooden buildings that surround the bazaar.  Just to the southwest can be seen the tree-shaded heart of the square, where citizens and adventurers gather for socializing, healing and rest.

title: [Wehnimer's, Narrow Alleyway]
description: This narrow, dead-end alleyway runs from town square to the south, up to a bare wall at the north end.  To the west, partially hidden behind teetering stacks of boxes, you see a weatherbeaten door with paint peeling off of it.

title: [Wehnimer's, Boatyard]
description: This promontory, formed of rocks and sand partially covered by weathered wooden docks, extends a short distance into the river. A refurbished frigate lies at anchor just offshore, awaiting a new cargo as well as a new lease on life.  The sand-covered riverbank beach stretches to the south.

title: [Upper Trollfang]

title: [Upper Trollfang]

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You are wandering through the grasslands of Lower Dragonsclaw.  This area is hilly, but not enough to justify the mountain which juts out from the ground to the east.

He sits and stares into the water, mumbling to no one in particular.

title: [A Stony Path]
description: A path of finely cobbled river stone winds northwest towards a narrow building perched on a slight rise in the landscape.  Twisted black pine trees lean over the pathway, their limbs entangled like the strands of a spider's web.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar Central]
description: The cobblestones give way here to the kinder spring of wood--wide, smooth planks fashioned into a large square and sealed with amber resin.  Benches and jute-seated sling-backs scatter across the area, most occupied by adventurers and townspeople who have stopped to rest their weary bones.  Sounds of laughter and mirth roll in from the east, pulling your gaze toward a canopied bar.  You notice right away that there are a few empty stools.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar Cantina]
description: Thousands of glasses, flutes and mugs hang inverted from a wooden rack that is nestled beneath the canopy.  Below them, the bar itself runs nearly the width of the square, its shiny laquered top mottled with shapes of light cast from colored lanterns lining the canopy's edge.  Occasional puffs of steam escape a large covered kettle set onto a hearth behind the counter, condensing in a film of sparkling droplets upon brass-handled taps which flank the brick.

title: [Teras Isle, River's Edge]
description: A strong river surges down from the southern mountain and away northeast toward the sea.  Across its width are strung a hundred sturdy ropes, intertwined through pulleys, anchored at both ends, and supporting an almost fluid wooden tunnel that bobs above the water as though likely to fall at any moment.  But the carved runes of countless dwarven craftsmen mark the entrance to the suspension bridge, and it is unlikely to fall before you grow old and grey.

title: [Teras Isle, Suspension Bridge]
description: Within the wooden tunnel of the bridge, you can see nothing of the river outside.  Still, there can be no doubt of where this tunnel is.  The sounds of rushing water, the creak of rope on wood, and the unending sway, all tell you this is no mine shaft.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: Low sloping hills stretch away from the river in all directions, rampant with tall clumps of grass.  Given the slightest excuse, flocks of birds break from hidden nests and wheel across the night sky, settling again like gently falling snow.  To the north, the land slopes quickly upward to the lower slopes of V'Tull.

To the north, the land slopes quickly upward to the lower slopes of V'Tull.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: Thick reedy blades of grass grow higher than most of the dwarves whose booted tracks crisscross the ground.  Gentle hills rise and fall, blocking your view of all but the inland peaks and the sky.

title: [Teras Isle, Old Road]
description: An ancient cobblestone road runs down a raised embankment toward the south end of the island.  The stones were once perfectly set so that a wagon must have passed over as if on a single sheet of stone.  But time unmakes all mortal labor, and no backs have toiled here for many seasons.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The eastern annex of the village is much smaller than the main part of the community across the river.  A dozen or so buildings once stood here, but like nearly everything else in this gloomy place, the rest have been destroyed by fire.

title: [Manor House, Porch]
description: An uncharacteristically cool breeze stirs the hundreds of honeysuckle blossoms which border this shady porch.  Slender columns of marble stand silent sentinel to the house beyond, marred only by great ribbons of vines which have wrapped firmly around their bases and gradually work their way upward.  One day, perhaps in the near future, this porch will be engulfed by the ravenous vegetation -- but for now, they provide a refreshing respite from the sultry temperatures outside.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A broken water wheel, half submerged in the middle of the river rushing past to the north, along with the burned remains of a building on the riverbank, suggest that some sort of mill once stood here.  However, you have seen no farmland, or suggestion of agriculture anywhere nearby that would possibly call for the need of a mill.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Between a pair of barbican towers, a constant stream of halfling farmers from the Olbin Strath and richly dressed human traders from Briarmoon Cove flows through the West Gate, with the occasional krolvin crew scattered among them.  Town guards inspect cargo, sharply dressed in dark blue and brown leathers emblazoned with the rampant mule that is the town's sigil.  Outside of the gates, the land is spotted with scraggly grasses and snows, and there is little tree cover.
The cobblestone road ends at the large western gate here.  Through the gate you see vast plains of grass about as tall as a halfling, with very few trees for cover.

title: [West Barbican, Gate]
description: Under the massive barbican is a shadowy passageway, with sturdy stone walls on each side and overhead.  Iron-barred windows provide access to this area from each of the barbican towers as well as from overhead, creating the distinct impression that someone is watching from the shadows.  The sharp spikes of raised portcullises jut from the ceiling at the eastern entrance to the city and the western exit to the wilds.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: A flow of adventurers, merchants, trappers, and lumberjacks congeals into a noisy throng near the South Gate of Icemule Trace.  Adding to the clack of wagon wheels and the din of the crowd, sounds of laughter and clanking mugs beckon from the inns and taverns that occupy the Tavern Burrow, just to the west.   The road lies in the shadow of the town's high walls and barbican towers, the foundations of which are of darker stone than the top.

Several groups of adventurers jostle past you on their way through the South Gate.  The sounds of laughter from the west remind you of the inns and taverns back home.  You notice that the lowest part of the wall is darker stone than the top, a sign that this fortification was raised at some point in the past.

title: [South Barbican, Gate]
description: Under the massive barbican is a shadowy passageway, with sturdy stone walls on each side and overhead. The sharp spikes of raised portcullises jut from the ceiling at the northern entrance to the city and the southern exit to the wilds.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Gate]
description: Pack mules bray from wide hitching posts to either side of the East Gate, laden with luggage and gear from travelers fixing to brave the snowy wilderness.  Crowds pass through the barbican beyond, a peculiar mix of returning adventurers, weary merchants, and serene monks and sisters from the abbey to the east.  A group of halfling children plays a game by the barbican towers, daring one another to run out into the wilds beyond.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Gate]
description: Thick stone walls frame a wide, wooden gate.  A vaulted stone archway provides some cover from the weather, which is often inclement so close to the glaciers.  The packed earth pathway skirting the town's walls gives way to a cobbled street in the same dark grey stone as the lower half of the walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Rising above the pathway which skirts the town are the blades of a windmill, which forms the southwestern corner of the town's wall.  The dark wood of the blades, as they turn to catch the wind, provides a sharp contrast to the light grey stone of the wall.

title: [A Snow-Covered Path]
description: The interwoven canopy of snowy boughs creates a tunnel effect on a narrow, secluded path that winds northeast towards a gate within a grey stone wall.  Fallen pine needles from the coniferous forest pad the trail with a fragrant carpet that both muffles footfalls and adds traction to the snow-covered ground.  The sound of wild songbirds in the trees occasionally trills through the area, and the scent of wood smoke beckons from further down the path.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: A sunbeam glints off a rock lying among many others scattered along the shore of the frozen river before you.  Across the river, which flows from the mountains and feeds the marsh, a few stubborn trees bravely line the bank.

title: [Icemule Trail, Icy River]
description: Moving cautiously over the ice-covered river, you scan the marsh that seems to extend forever past the northern bank.  You might be able to traverse that quagmire by stepping from hummock to hummock, but truly dry land seems scarce.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: This side of the mountain is covered with ice.  The ice field is almost big enough to be called a glacier, except that the conditions are all wrong for a glacier.  You suspect some sort of magic at work, and wonder at the wizard powerful enough to freeze half a mountain.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The ice glistens brilliant white, dazzling your eyes.  Frigid wind howls across the landscape, chilling you to the very marrow of your bones.  Upslope, to the west, you see a dark spot that might be a cave.  Even if it's not very deep, it might provide shelter for a while.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: The expanse of towering pines cloaked in clumps of snow is broken by the stark silhouette of a large, wrought-iron gate straddling the trail.  It is unattached to a fence of any kind.  Across the arched top are the words 'Pinefar Trading Post', crowned by a 'P' enclosed within a circle.  Although no buildings can be seen through the gusting snow, a smudge of smoke can be glimpsed curling above the trees.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: Swirling snow drifts at the feet of a row of towering pines.  They lean majestically over the path in a dark tunnel that stands as grandly as the nave of a cathedral.  No sound other than the whisper of the wind breaks the reverential hush reigning among the tall trees.

title: [Nine of Cups Cafe and Bar]
description: Here in the Cups, the knotty-pine walls are hung with a variety of game trophies and paintings.  A row of booths lines the back wall, and opposite them stands a long, low bar with a shining brass foot-rail.  Wooden panels suspended from the ceiling sway gently back and forth, propelled by a complex system of cords and pulleys that crisscrosses the wainscoting.  The panels whisper a lazy swish that keeps the air moving gently and dissipates the distinctive aroma of cigar smoke.

title: [Nine of Cups, Bar]
description: Faust's domain is one of highly polished wood and shining hardware.  Rows of glasses reflect light and the luster of brass fittings.  Candles with beaded shades are placed intermittently down the length of the counter, which add to the mellow gleam.  Over the bar hangs a monumental painting of a scantily clad, reclining halfling.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A sparkling peninsula of ice bridges the deep ravine in front of the garrison entrance.  High overhead, a lone falcon calls out as it passes, searching for prey.  Tiny tracks in the snow give evidence that there is more to this tundra than meets the eye.

title: [Snow Fort, Bridge]
description: Ice crunches beneath your feet as you carefully make your way along the bridge.  A deep ravine disappears into the distance below the bridge, causing you to briefly wonder on the countless souls who met oblivion below.  A translucent arch of ice and snow is carved into the side of the fort.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A chill wind blows down from beyond the glacier, rustling the sparse clumps of grass along the ground.  The high walls of Icemule Trace tower overhead, muffling the noises of the town beyond.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A small tower rises at this corner of the town walls, indistinct as the same stones comprise both structures.  The small windows high above are shuttered against the light of day.  Long and slender icicles dangle like fingers, pointing towards the ground.

title: [Sunfist Courtyard]
description: Enormous cobbles are fitted into the hard, cold ground to create a circular courtyard that houses a large stone-worked tower.  No windows adorn the face of the structure, which is broken by heavy modwir door, though the peak displays archer slits beneath the shelter of a thatch roof.  Dark shrubs, devoid of leaves, ring the cobbles in a well-manicured and tight-knit circle that is only broken near the southern end where a trail leads away from the tower.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The trees of the forest give way suddenly to a snowy clearing.  Several jagged-edged stumps peek cautiously from beneath their blanket of snow, as though inquiring if it is safe to come out.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: A light breeze stirs up the powdery snow on the ground, briefly obscuring the trails.  A thicket of blackberry brambles is covered with a delicate icing of snow.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Gate]
description: The wind whistles around you as it passes along this side of the town walls.  The road leading up to the gate itself is merely a dirt path but you notice it has seen some extensive use.  A huge snowbank is off to one side from all the snow being removed in front of the gates.  Just to the south of the gate is a stout building with a large sign over the door that reads "The Icehouse Tavern".

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Front Desk]
description: A narrow desk with a bouquet of forget-me-nots perched cheerfully on its top is set before a short hallway.  Highly polished lamps brighten up every corner of this crowded room, encouraging you to warm yourself before setting out again.  A crystal statue of a penguin, nearly as tall as a halfling, twinkles in the light.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Hall]
description: The hallway is every bit as cheerful as the other rooms of the Thirsty Penguin.  A round, stained-glass window marks the end of the hall and provides additional lighting when the conditions outside are just right.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Mistydeep River Dock]
description: The darkness of the Mistydeep swirls about the docks, the nearly black water impenetrable to the eye.  Several pleasure boats bob atop the gentle waves created by passing watercraft, bumping the padded edges of the dock.

title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]
description: Stone Valley stretches below you, burying itself in the twin peaks of Thanatoph to the southeast.  Carried on a gentle breeze, the sweet smell of wildflowers drifts up from the moonlit valley below.  A worn trail wends its way southeast into the valley through a row of elderberry brambles.

title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]
description: Winding to the southeast, the trail is choked by underbrush only to reappear again gasping for life some distance away.  Nearly tripping over a marmot hole, you stumble upon some bear droppings.  The stench is unbearable and you are forced to choke back your last meal.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, northwest, up

description: Someone has painted the cobblestones along the path here in varying shades of blue and purple, while the edges of the sidewalks are trimmed in gold.  Long, trailing ribbons of the same colors billow about the tall wrought iron lampposts spaced evenly up and down the sidewalks.

title: [Potting House, Garden]
description: Carmine dahlias sway lightly in the breeze, trailing down a gentle slope that smoothly levels off into a rustic, warm-toned garden.  Plump purple heirloom tomatoes hang heavy on deep green vines that wind their way up burnished bronze trellises staked in the supple earth.  Planted at the base of the stems, rows of marigold florets bud in solar shades of creamy yellow, vibrant orange, and rich burgundy.

title: [Hall of Brotherhood]
description: Members of the order walk along the stone floor under the graceful arch of the ceiling in hushed conversation, their footsteps echoing as they pass by.  Tapestries depicting key events in the order cover the walls extending eastward.

title: [Master's Hall]
description: The arched ceiling ends in a flat wall whose entire face is made of glass framed in arches of pure white ora.  Beyond the glass is a long row of greenery interspersed with flowers and shrubs.  Sunken into the floor is a lounge with tables and soft couches.  Intricate tapestries decorate the walls with scenes of the struggle to free the undead.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Occasional splashing waves wet the planks of the walkway here, making footing treacherous in places.  Warped and cracked planks are difficult to navigate and are in dire need of repair.  To the south, the Market Bridge rises out of the marsh and curving to the southeast, crosses Solhaven Bay into the heart of Solhaven.

title: [Market Bridge]
description: This section of the market bridge slopes strongly upward toward the center of the bridge high above the Cairnfang delta, and down into Marshtown to the north.  The timbers that make up the bridge are reinforced with thick ropes and iron bands.  Long spikes hold planks firmly in place.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Path]
description: The path makes a hairpin turn here, following the contour of the hills rising before you.  The rock-strewn path leads more or less downward in both directions, but there is also a faint trail leading up into the foothills.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: This rough, difficult trail leads up into the foothills towards the Trollfang Mountains.  The trees in this area are sparse and become even thinner at higher altitudes.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Snow Scramble]
description: Lack of handholds on the ice covered rock and piles of shifting snow on the trail make progress slow and painful.  A loud, shrill sound echoes down the wall of the mountainside.  One can only hope that it is the shriek of the wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Cave]
description: Snow billows into a tall tunnel and drifts against the walls.  A few steps from the mouth, the cave opens out into a wide cavern that is taken up almost entirely by a huge nest.  Tree branches, entire bushes, and other debris have been crudely woven together to form a roughly circular structure that would stand chest high to a giant.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Eddies and currents tug at the rafts of thickly-tarred barrels supporting this walkway that parallels the river.  Barrels of refuse line the boardwalk on either side.  A concerted effort has obviously been made to keep the marsh free of debris.  To the southwest, a crowded pier juts out into Solhaven Bay.  To the north, the walkway drives deeper into Marshtown.

title: [Marshtown, Surde's Pier]
description: The pier is long and wide, but is utilized primarily by small rowboats and skiffs used for shallow-water fishing.  The dock is packed with anglers who are busy trying to catch dinner or fish to sell at market.  Splatters and stains on the dock show that the fish caught here are often cleaned here.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A woven net hangs limply between two oaks, its web-like material tattered and broken.  Resembling a hammock, the net is cluttered with dead leaves and the broken ends of branches, its frayed ends hanging low enough to touch the leaf-covered earth.  A faint overgrown trail breaks off from the crumbling cobbled path, heading off into the deeper shadows of the woods.

title: [Outpost, Overgrown Trail]
description: Nearly consumed by creeping tendrils, wide-leafed ferns and prickly briars, the barely visible path winds its way through a forest of black oaks and the occasional yellow birch.  Hanging from a stout branch, a wooden placard about the size of a human face moves gently in the slight breeze.  The woven cord which suspends the placard is badly frayed, but appears strong enough to maintain its weight.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Fallen leaves from overhanging oak branches and greyish-green moss border the edges of the faint path running through the woods.  Probably a passage meant for use by small woodland rodents or swine, the run is little more than a twisting line of trampled undergrowth, nearly invisible among the thick ferns and shrubs of the forest floor.

title: [Charred Stump, Interior]
description: Even the passage of unknown years has not erased the sharp scent of burnt wood from this low, cramped hollow within the ancient stump.  The wooden walls of this tiny chamber have been ravaged by heat and stained by the thick smoke of the lightning-induced fire which tore the oak asunder and obliterated its uppermost reaches.  Dim light filters through two gouge-like openings in the old trunk, creating a passageway to another area of the woods.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crumbling Road]
description: The remains of an arch which once spanned the road now lie tumbled across it, making passage along the ancient roadbed difficult.  The once-jagged edges of the great stone blocks have been worn smooth with age, but carvings are still faintly visible on the broad bases that once held the structure aloft.  Wildflowers grow atop the tumbled blocks, giving them the look of a terraced garden and imbuing them with a beauty at odds with the ruin they represent.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Narrow Trail]
description: The passage through the trees is littered with stones and choked with densely grown underbrush.  Liana festoons the lower branches of the ancient trees which tower above you, the vines thicker than the trunks of some of the youngest trees.  The spicy scent of oak leaves only imperfectly masks a sharper animal smell.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: The clearing slopes down to the south toward an overgrown thicket of brambles and prickly holly trees.  A small rabbit skeleton lies nestled in the brambles.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Overgrown Path]
description: A fallen tree and a mass of low-hanging vines nearly block the path.  The thick growth prevents any breeze from reaching the path.  Nearby, a woodpecker works hard on another tree.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: A thicket of gnarled oaks forces the trail in a sharp bend, the trampled ground curving around what looks like a small clearing just behind the trees to the south.  The oaks' heavy trunks are etched with the marks of countless crude hatchets, the moss-covered markings somehow forming a pattern reminiscent of ancient runes.

title: [Valley, Oak Clearing]
description: The small, bright woodland clearing bounds a small overhanging ledge of granite on the south side, looking out over a scenic view of the vast wooded valley and the distant road beyond.  Thick moss carpets the flat, sun-warmed stone, and sparrows and finches flutter and chirp in the branches of the surrounding oaks.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The walkway turns abruptly southeast from here, while striking due west toward a large hill.  The buildings here sport signs reading "Jag Hill" and have shining steel numbers attached.  This section of town seems very well kept when compared with the rest of the sprawl.  A dark, narrow alley leads due south between two taller buildings.  Denuded of its mane by the elements, the skin of a cragviper is stretched on a tanning frame that hangs above a doorway just inside the alley.

title: [Marshtown, Bog Alley]
description: The buildings along this section of walkway are so close together that two people cannot walk abreast.  The proximity of the buildings blocks out the light, making the alley seem dark even at high noon.  Barrels of refuse and empty crates litter the alley, providing good hiding spots for derelicts and rogues alike.  Almost lost in the shadows is a door painted a dull, lifeless black.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The valley is lush with all varieties of life, from plants to birds to beavers and opossums.  A wide river to the west is crossed by a flat stone bridge which lies low to the river and stretches long from bank to bank.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The flat stones of the bridge have been expertly crafted to fit snugly together and provide safe passage across the water.  From the bridge, the river seems to flow by slowly with few ripples and no rapids.  Judging from the size of the river, however, it must flow swifter below than on the surface.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A stone cottage lies off the path to the north here, perhaps the home of a stonecutter judging by the tools and stones in the yard.  To the east, a flat stone bridge crosses a wide river.  To the west, the road continues across the valley.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the north, flowing in falls from the cliff face, running west through the black sands, and emptying into the ocean. The flow of fresh water from the east is steady and could not be crossed but for the bridge erected across the delta.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: From this bridge, the view of the falls to the east is wondrous.  Lush green trees border the falls atop the cliff face, and grass clings to the black, sandy banks of the delta.  Moonlight illuminates the crashing falls, providing a breathtaking silvery display which dazzles the eye in contrast to the black sands of the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the south, spanned by a weathered wooden bridge.  To the north, the beach is more cluttered with debris than to the south.  The looming cliff face to the east grows closer to the shore line to the north, giving the beach the illusion of disappearing into the distance.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Booths and stands have been set up along this section of the boardwalk.  Teams of merchants hawk fish and produce to travelers as they pass by from the docks on their way into town.  Clusters of people gather around each of the stands watching the merchants and customers haggle over prices.

title: [Marshtown, Glok's Pier]
description: This pier is crowded with merchants and sailors alike, all moving from ship to ship, and some from ship to shore.  Dozens of small sea craft anchor here, tied off by thick but worn ropes.  Taller mooring posts designed for ships and galleys are on the southern part of the pier.  A number of barrels litter the pier at various places, and a cast iron fish is fastened securely at its center.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: The planks on this section of the huge barrel-raft of the town are unusually thick and well maintained.  This may be due to the large pier to the south.  A number of larger ships dock there, and crewmen busy themselves moving barrels and crates from ship to shore and shore to ship.  The majority of Marshtown lies to the northeast.

title: [Marshtown, Fewr's Pier]
description: This pier is secured to pilings as thick as tall trees that are sunk deep into the mud of Solhaven Bay.  The thickly-tarred barrel raft extends under the pier, but is not used for support.  Caravels and large carracks dock at this pier, some bringing in wares and others docked for shore leave.  The pier is bustling with sailors.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chasm]
description: The floor gives way to a gaping pit spanned by a narrow bridge.  Stout pegs driven into the rock support the bridge, which rocks gently in the reeking current of air rising from the depths.  A nearby beam bears scratches that look like writing in the wan fungal glow.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Bridge]
description: Constellations of fungal growths as coldly bright as stars line the abyss beneath the bridge, but the ceiling of the chamber is in total darkness.  Unusually thick rope handholds and solid planks suggest that the builders of the bridge were not immune to the vertiginous illusory reversal of sky and ground.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chasm]
description: A humid breeze emanates from the yawning chasm to your west, carrying with it the too-sweet stench of tombs.  Luxuriant growths of lichen within the pit reveal the dark outline of a narrow bridge spanning it, but give no hint as to its depth.  The bridge itself has been kept scrupulously free of lichen, perhaps because the only way of seeing the span is by noting the dark path where the luminescent growth is not.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: A vibrant deciduous forest presses toward the waters of the Mistydeep River, leaving scant room for passage between the trees and the riverbank.  Cutting into the forest to the northeast, a well-maintained cobblestone road provides sure footing for travelers wishing to venture that direction, while a massive limestone bridge leads southwest, out over the river's waters toward an impressive city.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Vermilion Bridge]
description: Arcing gently across the river, the bridge spans the surface of the Mistydeep with a massive yet quiet grace.  The crennelated city wall across the water hides and protects the city within as far as the eye can see.  Atop the tremendous limestone walls florid ruby and golden pennants flutter in the breeze.

description: To the north, sunlight bathes an arbor in its warm glow.  Snapdragons in a kaleidoscope of color surround the arbor.  Covered with white clematis, the structure of the arbor is almost completely obscured.  A path of crushed, white marble leads to the arbor.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Arbor]
description: Moonlight filters through the leaves, casting its glow upon two curved benches that provide a place for quiet contemplation.  Cut from black marble and polished to a high gloss, the surface of the benches is worn with use.  Blanketed with clematis, the subtle fragrance of the creamy white flowers fills the air.

title: [Victory Road]
description: A small whirlpool forms in the center of the rapidly rushing water underneath the bridge.

A small whirlpool forms in the center of the rapidly rushing water underneath the bridge.  The jagged tops of huge boulders break the surface of the water, giving a clear indication of its depth.  A gentle mist from the waves crashing below causes the bridge to be quite slippery.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Victory Bridge]
description: Gracefully arcing above the murky depths of the Mistydeep River, the bridge's limestone blocks are so tightly fitted that seams are nearly invisible.  Thick bunches of rushes crowd the riverbank, as the chirping and whirring of insects hums through the air.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The path ends at this point, replaced by a rugged trail that winds through high rock walls.  There is little in the way of vegetation here, and a cold wind from the southeast whips at your clothing.  In that direction, you see the faint beginnings of a mountain pass.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The mountain pass here is narrow and the slope becomes more and more difficult to climb.  The way south is completely blocked by stones, boulders, and loose dirt, the rubble from an avalanche.  Just past the rubble you can barely see the beginnings of a rough trail.

title: [Monastery, Hallway]
description: This short hallway is quite plain in comparison to the intricate artistry and craftmanship of the other rooms.  Several doors line the hallway, each well fitted and free from any signs of the passage of time, and a low broad archway opens to the northwest appearing incongruously like the mouth of a giant carp.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Monastery, Chapel]
description: Colorful tiles form a mosaic on the floor of this small chapel.  There are no benches or pews, but there is a low kneeling rail at the west end of the room, separating the main chapel area from the altar to the west.

title: [Noralgar Road, Castle Approach]
description: The cold waters of Lough Ne'halin serve as a moat, wrapping around the feet of the cliff-like curtain wall girding the dark castle called Anwyn.  The old drawbridge stands open, spanning the lake and giving access to a barbican that guards the fortress's approach.

title: [Castle Anwyn, Drawbridge]
description: The rough timber planks of this drawbridge must be at least two feet thick, and are obviously of great antiquity.  Here and there, the surface of the bridge is mottled with the green of mosses and the pale gold of lichens.  But the integrity of the heartwood appears to be unbreached, with not a crack or spot of rot to be seen.  Beneath it, the forbiddingly cold water of the lake ripples silently.

title: [The Emerald Pool]
description: The cave widens here and the rough floor drops away leaving you wading in cool, shallow water.  Looking around, you have a feeling of an otherworldly silence, as the sounds of your splashing are not reflected back to you by the cavern walls.  Below you, underneath the surface of the water, you see a faint emerald glow emanating from a small opening.

title: [A Tidal Cave]
description: Years of tidal erosion have carved out a rough cave large enough for unrestricted movement.  Cool seawater laps around your ankles and the light filtering in from the cave mouth reflects off the resulting wavelets in a hypnotic display.  The tunnel extends southward, deep within the cliff, but peering in that direction you notice that the light does not diminish into blackness.  Far into the cave, you can barely make out a faint emerald glow illuminating the rough walls.

title: [Sea Cave, Limestone Cliff]
description: Your heart skips a beat as you look into the plummeting depths of the ravine below, into a lively, roiling underground river.  Above, the cave ceiling forms a dome with a jagged opening to the surface.  Through the opening, a narrow beam of silver light shines on the various rock formations and reflects off the mica deposits in glittering, hypnotic patterns.  A wide slab of rock spans the river, forming a natural bridge to the west side of the ravine.

title: [Sea Cave, Stone Bridge]
description: From either side of this wide rock slab you can see the river rushing under you.  The dangerous speed of the current whips foam and spray around the rocks below.  You carefully stay away from the edges as you make your way to the other side.

title: [Sea Cave, Limestone Cliff]
description: You are on a broad limestone cliff between a towering wall of sheer rock and the deep river ravine.  The distant howl of wind and surf echoes dimly from outside.  It reverberates and booms until it sounds like the wailing of the damned.  The cliff curves around the wall to the southwest.  A crevice in the wall opens a passageway heading northwest.  The natural stone bridge provides a convenient way to cross the river.

title: [House of Paupers, Entry Hall]
[Paupers, Entry Hall]
description: Deep fur floor covering cushions your feet as you walk past opulent portraits of distinguished explorers and huntsmen dressed in stiff, formal attire.  The far end of the room is dominated by a plush comfortable sofa and several overstuffed chairs near tables on which lie scrolls of Wehnimer Edition.  You approach a large oaken desk, behind which sits a poised, elven receptionist who looks up just as you glance through the ora door to her right.

title: [Paupers, Wide Hall]
description: This wide, carpeted hallway is quiet and peaceful.  At the end of the hallway are some wide double doors, above which is a rosette stained glass window.  Sunlight illuminates the glass, casting the hallway in bright colors.  An ornate winding staircase leads up, and a lapis-inlaid plaque hangs next to an ora-bound door.

title: [Krag Slopes, Dark Cave]
description: Within the breach, an odious smell makes breathing a supreme effort.  A half-eaten carcass of some undistinguishable animal protrudes from a recess on the far wall.

title: [Krag Slopes, Darkened Recess]
description: This must be the sleeping area of some creature, though how anything could sleep in the vile stench is beyond normal reasoning.  A pile of filthy, reeking furs dominates the recess, apparently a bed of sorts.

title: [Liabo Circle, Ronan's Way]
description: An enormous dwarf walks his dog down this tree-lined, cobblestone street.  The dog is tiny, barely even a cat, but looks quite jaunty with a big, bright pink ribbon around its neck.

title: [Liabo Circle, Wooded Path]
description: The path wanders through a leafy glade, meandering about like a preoccupied child.  A few small buildings crouch among the trees.  From one, you hear faint strains of a lyre.

title: [Liabo Circle, Lumnis' Way]
description: Tall modwir trees, thick-limbed and lush-leaved, arch over the street.  The serenity of the perpetual gloom below is unbroken, save for the soft cooing of a dove hidden somewhere in the dark bowers.

title: [Liabo Circle, Shaded Path]
description: The path curves through a grove of willow trees.  Some snug wooden homes have been built beneath their long, flowing leaves.  A gentle breeze from the west stirs them into whispering motion.

title: [Tiger Court Lane]
description: Neatly cobblestoned lanes extend off in three directions, lined by rows of thick shade trees that filter dappled light onto the varicolored stone.  Cottages of brick and wood line the streets, bounded by colorful flowerbeds and neatly trimmed bushes.  A large calico cat rests in a patch of sun at the end of a shaded path between the trees.

title: [Tiger Court, Garden]
description: The garden is covered in cats.  They come in all shapes, sizes and colors, making the small plot of land a sea of particolored fur.  They rub against each other or bathe in the dirt, busily lazy in the warm sun.  The plants have certainly seen better days, however, as each bears a mark of some feline's tender mercies.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Tall orange grass shaped in tight spirals covers the fine sand of this beach.  The spring-like plants bounce upward with every passing breeze, the motion scattering the many tiny golden butterflies that are flittering about the stalks.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A tiny toy boat bobs placidly near the dock, far too small to carry any passengers.  It is not attached with any rope, yet for some odd reason, it does not float off with the tide.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A rickety pier has been built along the beachside and it leads off to provide a short walkway over the sea.  The wood is warped from the constant moisture in the air, and the entire structure looks unsafe at best.  A battered sign has been posted.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.

The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.  A watery vortex churns dangerously in the waters just below the pier, its center crackling with energy.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The valley widens out here into a large open area heavily carpeted with tall grass.  A rocky pass heads north out of the valley, ascending into the hills to the north.  A stream tumbles down the south wall in a large waterfall, filling a lake at the base of the wall.

title: [Rocky Pass]
description: The rock-strewn floor of this pass leads on between towering black stone walls.  Piles of broken stone at the base of the walls show where pieces have fallen in the past.  The wind causes a lonely whistling sound as it blows through the pass.  A few stunted bushes indicate how difficult it is for anything to survive in such inhospitable and rocky ground.

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Dwarven miners wander in and out of the stone arch to the south.  Those proceeding north are dusty and grimy, their faces covered by a layer of sweaty dirt and their beards tangled.  In contrast, those proceeding south are clean and neat, with washed faces and combed beards.  The tunnel to the south appears to be tighter, of much rougher construction than the surrounding area, and also poorly lit.  The dwarves moving in and out seem to pay no attention to the change in construction.
from.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: Roughly hewn, unfinished timbers support a ceiling and chiseled walls that still bear the marks of the miner's pick.  The only attempts at finishing seem to have been limited to the floor.  Though it is fairly level and smooth, a thick carpet of dust and mining debris makes footing hazardous.  A lone amber toadstool in a stone pot lights the passageway, and a pair of steel rails follow the east wall, disappearing through closed doors at the north end of the tunnel.
to.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Rockslinger Relocation Services]
description: Several crates stand in one corner, all marked with the same destination.  The rest of the room is austere.  Only a stone desk and straight-backed chair break up the monotony of a grey granite floor, grey granite walls, and grey granite ceiling.  Two huge luminescent toadstools in large stone pots, each occupying opposite corners, appear sufficient to light the room.  A steel door allows exit to the corridors of Zul Logoth, a dark hallway extends to the west, and a wide corridor extends south.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although quite a bit of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

A steel door allows exit to the corridors of Zul Logoth, a dark hallway extends to the west, and a wide corridor extends south.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and south, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  To the north the corridor widens out into a spacious room, while to the south extends more corridor.

title: [Orcswold, Low Moors]
description: The fields spread out into a low, boggy field to the south, featureless except for a grassy mound of earth that rises from the flat landscape just to the south.  No creatures seem to have built their nests here, and a flicker of odd, crackling energy, like a nearby storm, passes through the air.

description: Wooden planks worn smooth by years of constant use line the floor of the tavern, strewn with fresh rushes and smelling slightly of ale.  Several elves are crowded around an ornately carved bar that runs the length of one wall, drinking and conversing quietly.  A few tables, each decorated with a lone candle as centerpiece, are scattered about the tavern.

title: [Hagatha's Brew and Barley]
description: Behind the oak bar, many rough-hewn pegs contain a variety of clay tankards while matching shelves in one corner are filled with wooden platters.  A narrow doorway leads out to the grill, from which a variety of mouth-watering smells emanate.  The bar itself is quite high and ornately carved with random scenes of bountiful harvest.  Curiously, there are no stools, though the counter has a smooth lip which appears perfect for leaning.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Marsh Edge]
description: An old wagon lies buried in the mud near the shore of a murky bog, dark green lichen already finding a home upon its timbers.  A light green carpet of minute plant life floats on the surface of the stagnant water, an occasional bubble parting the greenery as it expands outwards toward the shore.  At the edge of the marsh, stands of cattails mark the entrance to a shadowed archway beneath the burdened boughs of an ancient willow tree.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Murky water surrounds a collection of cypress trees, the broad roots sinking deep into the mud.  Buttonbush speckles the tufted sedge that borders the faint pathway forking around a small pond.  Elven moss and poison ivy lines the cypress knees sitting nearby, overshadowing the trail with their silhouettes in the dim sunlight.

title: [Fearling Pass, Forest Trail]
description: Uncommonly wide, the pass appears to be able to accommodate the girth of an army, though some of the ruts in the dirt trail are by no means fresh and signal that more peaceful era has passed.  Crowded trees filled with singing birds hug both sides and extend back farther than the eye can see.

title: [Woodland Path]
description: Tiny golden, white, and purple violets grow up through the crevices between the riverstones of a meandering path, while hostas line its edges.  Lilacs flank the hostas, and taller shrubs and trees grow in orderly succession along the path's length.  Soft burbles in the distance indicate the source of the forest's verdant fecundity.

title: [Foothills]
description: Silvery schools of fish leap and swirl through the clear water of the nearby stream.  A narrow trail leads along the side of the stream, following the rise of the land to the east where the low hills meet the edges of higher stone cliffs.  A wider path descends down the hill to the west.

title: [Grassland]
description: A path leads down to a bridge that crosses the stream to the south and up the hilly slope to the northeast.  A small patch of violets grows to the side of the trail, forming a soft blanket on the lush green carpet of the tall grass.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry]
description: Slender oak columns frame this grand entry hall, whose pale granite walls rise the full two stories of the building.  The columns support a second floor gallery, reached by a sweeping staircase and bordered by a heavily carved balustrade from which are hung dozens of banners bearing crests of ancient elven families.  The east and west walls are pierced by tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows, through which dappled sunlight pours into the hall.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The rich cherrywood paneling of this long hallway is punctuated by polished brass sconces, whose steady glow reflects from the ivory coffered ceiling.  A thick wool runner, woven in jewel-hued shades of green and blue, muffles the footsteps of passersby from the scholars of the adjacent library.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: An ancient cobblestone road leads from the Mistydeep off into the steadily thickening forest to the southeast.  Two black marble drakes, their attitude of repose belied by one half-opened eye, rest on either side of a massive limestone bridge that crosses the water in the direction of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Annatto Bridge]
description: Thick rushes crowd the bottom of the bridge, their brown heads nodding in the gentle night breeze.  The musical croaking of frogs mingles with the rustle of the fronds they live within.  The occasional tiny wave cascading from the Mistydeep splashes near the foot of the bridge, making the footing slightly treacherous.

title: [Plains of Bone, Outer Circle]
description: A deep pit has been dug between the two walls.  Dozens of skeletons lie in the bottom of the pit.  Snakes curl their way through the forest of bones, their scales glinting in the moonlight.  A plank spans the pit.

title: [Plains of Bone, Plank]
description: Looking downward, only blackness and bones can be seen.  Cobwebs dangle from the bottom of the plank, glistening with moisture in the moonlight, along with decaying leaves that have been caught up in the webs.  The plank ends not far to the north.

description: The faint outlines and twisting pathways of the animal run seem to terminate in a small trampled clearing.  The black oaks which dominated the run have given way to tall pines, whose fresh aroma now fills the area.  The clearing is bathed in a strange silence and a tense, semi-perceptible energy lingers in the air, as if in wait.

title: [Charred Stump, Interior]
description: Even the passage of unknown years has not erased the sharp scent of burnt wood from this low, cramped hollow within the ancient stump.  The wooden walls of this tiny chamber have been ravaged by heat and stained by the thick smoke of the lightning-induced fire which tore the oak asunder and obliterated its uppermost reaches.  Dim light filters through two gouge-like openings in the old trunk, creating a passageway to another area of the woods.

title: [River's Rest, Spring Rest]
description: All about, leaves and small twigs litter the forest floor, but at the forest's edge, in this clearing, brush marks in the soft dirt show the care that someone takes here.  A pool of clear water dominates the area and feeds a small stream which meanders southward beside a small path.  At the edge of the clearing, two large stone pillars mark a pathway west.  Moonlight filters through the trees and seems to invite the weary to rest here in peace.

description: Grey and cracked, the thick planks of the pier are roughly cut. Clumps of water lilies float on the water's surface on either side of the raised wooden platform, their sweet fragrance filling the air with a heady scent.  The pier stretches out deep into the water to the east, finally culminating at a lighthouse.

title: [Troll Lair, Pet's Room]
description: Ugh! What a smell you've discovered.  The combination of wet grass, animal musk, and urine almost makes you pass out.  Only the revolting thought of falling into the moldy grass that covers the floor keeps you awake.

title: [Troll Lair, Hall]
description: The hall is strewn with droppings, litter, and animal parts, making footing difficult at best.  Among the debris can be seen various bits of leather and metal that appear to have once been armor.  A fouler stench wafts in from the northeast.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Pebble Court, Park]
description: A field of roses, red and yellow, wafts gently with the breeze.  Among the blooms are several statues of black marble, one for each of the light-aligned Arkati.

title: [Pebble Court Park, Gazebo]
description: The gazebo is polished brass, gleaming brightly as a halfling at breakfast.  Delicately carved benches of white modwir are set in a semi-circle, surrounding a small, raised stage.  The gazebo walls are lined with small, clay pots, each of which is home to a single red rose.

Polished to a bright shine, the brass frame of the gazebo reflects the sunlight with a brilliant gleam.  Carved benches of white modwir are set in a semi-circle, surrounding a narrow, raised stage.  A small copper-rimmed barrel sits to one side, its base encircled by a ring of wildflowers.  Tall, clay pots that line the walls are each home to a single red rose.

title: [Pebble Court, Park]
description: Blue and orange tulips have been planted along the edges of a small pond.  The waters are dark and still, reflecting and enhancing the blooms' beauty.

description: Sky, sea, and soil blend together in a monotonous haze of darkness.  The only breaks in the dreary sameness are the occasional sulfurous mist that drifts down the volcanic slopes to the north and the jagged black line to the east that marks the cliffs known as the Dark Palisade.

title: [Dark Palisade, Lovers' Leap]
description: The desolate moor gives up life to a jagged cliff of jet black volcanic rock and the grey sea beyond.  Cold wind carries the spray of the waves below against the rocks and howls up the face of the cliff below.  It draws a mournful wail from the dark stone as it hurtles onto the moor, blowing the tenacious shrubs into drawn and flat shadows of their normal shapes.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Reception Area]
description: Encased in polished oak walls, the tidy office is fitted with a limestone floor that has alabaster striations mixed with slate blue veins.  Several rugs in matching hues compliment the floor, as do the Vornavian silk drapes framing the large picture windows that face the street.  Numerous oak benches line the walls, while cushioned chairs surround a desk set in the middle of the room.  Beyond the desk, a well-lit corridor leads further into the building, and is lined with books and bulletins boards.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Corridor]
description: Framed in oak and set with a long tapestry rug, the corridor is lined with bookcases and bulletin boards that are filled with reading materials.  Standing opposite one another, with brass sconces to illuminate them, are a pair of matching doors fitted with slender brass plaques.  Further down the corridor are another set of doors, while to the south, a reception area can clearly be seen with its large desk set in the center.

title: [Chimney Top]
description: Emerging from the stone chimney, the view of the Locksmehr River valley below is spectacular.  To the east, the town of Wehnimer's Landing is clearly visible, as are the sparkling waters of Darkstone Bay.  Off to the north, one can see how the forest gives way to the coastal cliffs and black sands.  Movement here is severely limited, with the only real choices being back down the stairs or across the jagged chasm to the west via a narrow rope and wood suspension bridge.

title: [Bridge]
description: Gaps in the boards below reveal a dizzying drop to the jagged chasm floor.  The bridge sways with each footfall, and periodic shifts in the wind cause minor buffeting.  To the east, the chimney rock looms large against the sky.  The west end of the bridge is secured to a relatively small, flat mesa occupied by an unusual structure.  Rough-hewn stone pillars, far larger than the marker below, form a large circle around a central wood and stone building there.

title: [Courtyard]
description: Within the ring of massive stone pillars that comprise this courtyard, the air is unnaturally calm and the atmosphere serene.  Fenvaoks, normally seen at much lower altitudes, flit through the air, chirping merrily.  Small shrubs form a ring inside the pillars, and a lush carpet of grass fills the area.  Lining a series of spoke-like pebbled paths, each bracketed by wrought iron benches, rows of flowers extend from the courtyard to the triskele building at the circle's hub.

title: [Triskele, West Corridor]
description: Stout modwir timbers are symmetrically spaced between walls of precisely fitted stone blocks, each carved with a detailed bas-relief scene depicting battle with orcs, ogres, or trolls.  Shining down through glaes panel skylights of irregular thickness, sunlight dances over the carvings, creating an illusion of movement.  Corridors branch off to the northwest and southwest, while the entrance lies to the east.

Several comfortable looking chairs are pulled to the side of the fireplace, close enough to enjoy the fire without getting too warm.

title: [The Lost Home, Patio]
description: A great oak stands in the middle of the enclosed patio, its spreading branches providing both shade and protection from the elements.  The Lost Home's two wings wrap around either side of the area, enclosing a few quaint tables from the walkways beyond.  Across the lawn, a small pond is fed by a narrow brook that encircles the massive tree.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Atrium]
description: A skylight two stories above allows natural light to flood this room, giving it the feel of an outdoor cafe.  Set into the grey marble pillars surrounding the atrium are metal planters filled with a variety of flowers, plants, and hanging vines. title: [Temple of Jastev, Courtyard]
description: Grey stone cobbles run the length of the courtyard, meeting the rough protective walls.  Small shrubbery and ornamental trees line the interior of the walls as they gently curve towards the tower.  A small path cuts a more direct route to the entrance past a grand fountain.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Fountain]
description: A magnificent fountain stands nobly in the center of this clearing.  The ring of yew trees provide certain shelter to anyone caring to spend some time listening to its flows.  Glancing around you can spy the occasional devotee sliding past on the exterior circle, while a monk or two sit in careful meditation at the fountain edge.

title: [Curlew Brook, Lower Slope]
description: Dappled sunlight filters through the branches of the ancient trees that dot this stretch of the riverbank, making the pure whites of scattered wildflowers growing amid the grassy lawns between the trees all the brighter.  The raked gravel path curves around a circular, granite open-air hearth, with a stack of split cordwood stored in a small wooden shelter close to hand.

title: [Curlew Brook, Swimming Dock]
description: Crafted of wide modwir planks, this dock juts out into the deep waters of the Mistydeep, allowing swimmers easy access to the deeper flows of the river.  A dragonfly perches on the narrow boardwalk leading westward, back to shore.

title: [Limne Var]
description: Stretched along the bank, a large hoarbeam building dominates the river's edge.  Amaranth, pansies, and fire lilies fill the beds to each side of its fel door, while swathes of wisteria festoon its beams and lintels.  Bending down to greet their cousins, baskets of ivy and petunias overflow on windowsills.  Boisterous conversation carries from the terrace to the river side of the building.

title: [Curlew Brook Bridge]
description: The turbulent water of a small creek chatters endlessly below this graceful span, creating tiny waterfalls and whirlpools as it makes its final descent towards the Mistydeep River. description: Velvet-covered divans and settees rest comfortably against the white stucco walls, leaving the golden linden dance floor free of clutter. Frosted glass globes fitted with tiny candles dangle from the vaulted ceiling to lend the room soft illumination and hang thickest over a pair of decorative serving tables.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Foyer]
description: Oriel windows, graced with recessed window seats, are framed in azure draperies of soft Vornavian silk that pools in placid folds upon the polished floors.  Fitted between the arched entryways set at the room's cardinal points, are cozy linden chairs and matching tables.  Resting in the center of the floor is a plush emerald green rug richly designed with the image of a peacock, while a blue silk banner hangs above stained glass doors.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Thick emerald green curtains of soft Vornavian silk stand parted to allow silver moonlight to trickle through the glass-paned bay windows, which are fitted with window seats covered in periwinkle blue cushions.  Pewter wall sconces, hung between framed portraits, run the length of the western wall of this arched gallery, while an enormous kraken sculpture stands alone opposite them upon a curved pedestal.  Suspended to the right of a double archway is a delicate glass picture.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Foyer]
description: Oriel windows, graced with recessed window seats, are framed in azure draperies of soft Vornavian silk that pools in placid folds upon the polished floors.  Fitted between the arched entryways set at the room's cardinal points, are cozy linden chairs and matching tables.  Resting in the center of the floor is a plush emerald green rug richly designed with the image of a peacock, while a blue silk banner hangs above stained glass doors.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Entrance]
description: The eldest of the yews here have grown into a great canopy, almost blotting out the sky.  Great shadows play through their branches, dancing over the tower steps.  The dim lights on the rough exterior walls give a very somber tone to the entrance here.  A small path parts the wall of foliage, carrying the faint sound of trickling water.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Fountain]
description: A magnificent fountain stands nobly in the center of this clearing.  The ring of yew trees provide certain shelter to anyone caring to spend some time listening to its flows.  Glancing around you can spy the occasional devotee sliding past on the exterior circle, while a monk or two sit in careful meditation at the fountain edge.

title: [Temple, Right Hand Way]
description: A narrow slitted window rises high on the western wall, rays of sparkling sunlight filtering through to lend an ethereal glow to the room.  The gracefully arched wings of a genderless statue set in front of the window cast faint shadows across the brightly-lit chamber, and the figure's face bears no sign of emotion.  A pale granite arch opens in the east wall, while a small alcove to the south leads to a well-lit chamber.

title: [Temple, Garden of Silence]
description: Creeping ivy spreads across the dappled granite that makes up the temple walls enclosing this peaceful little garden, where small patches of lilies of the valley add a faint touch of brightness to the silent grey-green surroundings.  An ancient yew tree, its huge trunk gnarled and bent over a curved stone bench, stretches its limbs across the enclosed courtyard.  Its tapered leaves shift and seem to rustle in the errant currents of wind, but there is no sound, nor any sound of birds or buzzing insects.

title: [Watchtower, Triage]
description: Running from floor to ceiling on the western wall is a series of whitewashed cabinets with etched glass fronts.  Standing directly beside them is a short writing desk covered with an orderly pile of papers and journals.  Wide examination beds, four in all, occupy the center of the room and are covered with crisp white linens, while a pair of river reed baskets hang around the arch leading into the central foyer.

title: [Watchtower, Foyer]
description: Crafted entirely of limestone, this vaulted room is adorned with pennants and banners depicting the allies of Solhaven as well as the H.E.R.T. coat of arms.  Deep blue rolton wool rugs stretch the expanse of the oak floor and provide a cushion for the room's centerpiece, a replica of the Sea Wolf.  Beneath the supports of a circular staircase are some wide double doors leading to the courtyard beyond, while a crest-adorned oak door leads to the streets.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Temple, Left Hand Way]
description: Featureless, smooth walls of dark grey granite enclose the darkened hallway.  Three black pillar candles set into recessed niches do little to drive back the cloying shadows that embrace the passage in shifting darkness.  A faint light filters in through the grey granite arch in the inner wall, and the vague outline of a small alcove leads into a dark chamber to the south.

title: [Superintendant's Office]
description: A single stone bench is the only furniture, yet upon each wall hangs a painting depicting a different battle scene.  The floor is bare and clean.

title: [Outpost Tunnel]
description: The warm air hangs still in this subterranean corridor, surrounded by the hill on all sides.  Torches mounted along the walls merely illuminate the way, as there are no decorations or furniture to cast their light on.  The tunnel forks, leading toward a tall stone door to the northeast and a square stone door to the northwest.  A round steel hatch claims an unusual place in the tunnel's ceiling.

title: [Taskmaster's Office]
description: Several rush lights hang from the high ceiling which tops this perfectly square room.  Thick wooden beams support the ceiling at the corners and in the exact midpoint of each wall.  In the middle of the room is a heavy desk, built to completely surround the wooden beam that rises right through its center up to the ceiling.

title: [Bridge of Tall Steps]
description: The stair passes over a yawning abyss, its floor occasionally obscured by low-flying wisps of cloud.  At the steps' conclusion stands an imposing arched door, offering entrance into a towering edifice with walls rising in ivory colored grace to a cantilevered roofline high overhead.  On the handrail, a small sign is mounted, announcing this to be The Aerie, a famous theater owned and maintained by the local Bardic Guild.

title: [Bard Guild, Auditorium Lobby]
description: The Guild Auditorium is an architectural marvel, balanced upon the top of a graceful pillar that blossoms as it rises from a narrow circumference at its base on the canyon floor.  Constructed in light-toned cantilevers, the auditorium is both expansive with its high ceilings, and at the same time, gives the impression that it was built using clouds as its gist.  From the lobby, a row of three vaulted arches gives access to the auditorium.

title: [Bard Guild, Open Walkway]
description: The open-air walkway -- in truth a bridge -- spans a deep chasm between the Bard Guild sitting on the edge of the cliffs and the spectacular Aerie Auditorium poised upon a single pillar standing out from the ramparts.  The column tapers as it descends and from the height of the walkway it gives an illusion that the structure perched on top is floating on the head of a pin.  All along the low, moonlight-sparkled stone walls grow a tangle of wisteria vines with their fragrant cascades of blue flowers.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate is brightly lit by an eahnor oil lamp crafted in the shape of a crescent moon.  A row of tall, grey marble pillars separates the walkway from the skylit atrium beyond.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Atrium]
description: A skylight two stories above allows natural light to flood this room, giving it the feel of an outdoor cafe.  Set into the grey marble pillars surrounding the atrium are metal planters filled with a variety of flowers, plants, and hanging vines.  A burbling fountain in the center of the room makes the illusion complete.  Overhead, a row of black granite pillars surrounds the upper cloister, with a gallery of stained glass windows hanging between them.

title: [Northern Fortress, Great Hall]
description: Set with oak double doors in each wall, this large room is lit by oil-lamps that hang from the ceiling.  A stone fireplace rests in one corner, with a basket of sticks nearby.  Around the fireplace, thirteen portraits of battle-arrayed persons have been hung, while a large collection of paintings adorns the remaining walls.  Bearskin rugs cover the floor, comfortable leather couches line the walls, and there is a sturdy wastebasket adjacent to the fireplace.

title: [Northern Fortress, Ready Room]
description: Sheathed with oak planking, the walls and floor give the room a rustic, yet purposeful air.  Each wall contains a double door leading to other areas of the keep, while hanging from high above are several large tapestries.  Well lit by oil-lamps dangling from the rafters, the chamber prominently displays a giant banner stretched over the southern doorway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Beacon Hall, Display Room]
description: A long gallery of white marble shot with reddish veins extends along nearly the entire length of Beacon Hall.  Several arches on the west wall provide a splendid view across Maelstrom Bay.  A soft breeze filters through open windows, carrying a hint of sea salt and meadow flowers and causing three crystal chandeliers overhead to tinkle musically.  On the east wall, imposing glass display cases contain replicas and artifacts of historical significance.

title: [Beacon Hall, Terrace]
description: Lush foliage and scented blooms surround the terrace, providing a colorful frame for a magnificent view of the bay.  Sunlight sparkles off the distant waters.  Thick vines burst through an open canopy overhead, blanketing the area in a cloud of pale purple flowers.  Feathery ferns rim brick walkways, and red-blossomed trees enfold a stone bench, an elegant statue, and a sculptural fountain.  A large gazebo provides ample space for a band and dancers to gather.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: A dimly lit hallway leads north into the shadows and east into a darkened chamber from which quiet sounds of whispered conversations and laughter drift in.  A black-clad giantman stands guarding the hallway, his deceptively friendly smile glinting in the torchlight as he looks you over.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: The hall is panelled with dark wood and hung with heavy tapestries that dull the sounds of footsteps.  Illuminated only by the glow from the torches to the south, the passage continues north into darkness.  A draft of cool air occasionally wafts in from a narrow stairway that leads up through an opening in one wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cavern]
description: The twisting corridor splits into two passages, one of which veers suddenly downwards.  A spiralling stair has been carved into the stone to aid the unwary traveler, but each step varies from its cousins in width and height, making for uneasy purchase.  Intaglio carvings adorn the walls, the smoothness of the stone attesting to their use as easy handholds as well as decoration.

title: [Wizard Guild, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Intaglio carvings cover the walls of the narrow stone tunnel, which rises upward toward a bright opening to the east.  Steps barely visible to the eye are hewn into the floor of the tunnel, offering some purchase for those wishing to pass through its dark length.  The air is disturbed by a faint breeze flowing westward back toward the caverns.

title: [Wizard Guild, Nexus]
description: Bright sunlight streams into the stone room through a partially collapsed vaulted dome ceiling, the rubble of which lies piled against the north wall of the room.  Along the edges of the ceiling hang vines and tree roots, noting the encroachment of a jungle, whose leafy green treetops are visible through the breached roof.  A small water fountain lies dormant in the center of the room, surrounded by small stone benches.  The shrieks of birds and the occasional trollish roar filter in from the outside.

description: Elegantly carved and decorated wooden benches surround the ancient fel tree centered in this portion of the grove.  The tree looks fairly healthy, but clearly age and animals have taken their toll on its proud form.

title: [Warrior Guild, Storage]
description: The groundskeepers evidently utilize this area as storage.  Piled in large stacks are wooden planks, the weather and climate slowing damaging the supplies.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Landing]
description: The downward side of this trail rests at the pivot of a giant, stone draw bridge and continues upward to the east.  The ledge is narrow here, and there is an overhang above which limits your view.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Stone Bridge]
description: The stone bridge is smoothly cut and has weathered its age well with few cracks.  It spans the gap between the east and west ledge easily.  Two large, hemp ropes on either side run tautly up to slots in an overhang above.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: Choked by the broken pieces of floating grass meadows pushed downstream, the murky river narrows considerably and begins a gradual path to the southeast.  Moonlight glistens off of the river as it ripples with the current, providing brief illumination through the hazy mist permeating the air.  The shadowy forms of grass flowers, their spindly stems twisting and turning in the slight evening breeze, flutter about the area as they are carried downstream.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Landing]
description: Tethered to the dock, the surrounding river rafts rock gently back and forth as the water course ripples on its way to the southeast.  Smooth stones line the damp banks of the river on the western side, where they create a small decorative barrier between the jungle and the docks.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: Sunlight slants across the cobblestone street and illuminates the windows of the edifice that has an elegant painted sign dangling over its entry.  Lost in the shadows of the large building, a small alley stretches to the south and offers a glimpse of the street below.  Entwined with sunset-hued plumerias and lined with benches, a white picket fence creates a protective barrier that prevents pedestrians from falling down the sheer cliff on the other side.

Standing opposite the alley, a small white-columned store has an elegant sign positioned above its entry that is painted with a bright blue pelican.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Alley]
description: Short and wide, the cobblestoned alley rests between several large buildings and stretches between Pelican and Cormorant Lane.  Doors leading to the backrooms of shops pockmark the structures to either side and have tightly lidded barrels next to them.  Painted in bright colors, a nearby brick wall depicts blocks of cheese, fresh breads, wine bottles, and glasses, while a pair of brass lanterns illuminates a low gate that leads into a small cafe.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Cormorant Lane]
description: Strong, acrid scents rise from the surf as it crashes against a low stone wall that separates the southern edge of the street from the waters of the harbor.  Sandwiched between two buildings, a small alley provides quick access to the north, while a sandy pathway leads to the beaches in the east.  Wild ducks, their sporadic quacking filling the air, swim in the cool waters and occassionally beg for treats.

description: Wide windows fitted into the smooth teak walls of the building provide an excellent view of the pier and docks that jut out into the harbor.  Neatly bisecting the room, a long wooden counter separates a young elven clerk from the open floor of the shop.  Standing opposite the entry, a tall arch leads to the property's private boats.

title: [Bliss Island Rentals, Dock]
description: Blue, green, and red ribbons, their long ends left loose to dangle towards the water of the harbor, weave in and out of the various slats and poles of the railing that encircles the docks.  Benches frame the area and provide ample spaces for visitors to sit while waiting for passage to one of the islands.  Anchored to the pylons by enormous wrought iron hooks are dormant lanterns, their polished glass windows gleaming in the golden sunlight.

title: [Cavernhold, Deep Canyon Room]
description: The thundering roar of crashing water pounds through the blackness of a deep canyon that cuts through this room.  Spanning the chasm and the unseen river below is a narrow natural bridge of grey and red rock.

title: [Cavernhold, Natural Bridge]
description: Great plumes of water billow from the deep canyon in the form of a silver mist which coats the surrounding rock in a thin film of shimmer dew.  The wet stone is beautiful to view as the moisture has released the vibrant natural colors.

title: [Cavernhold, Guard Post]
description: Scores of torches mounted in carved sconces line the top of a low stone wall the prevents any further travel to the west.  The muted conversations of Gnoll guards hang in the air like the smoke of the flickering light sources.
