title: [Foyer]
description: Expansive, rigidly perpendicular, and made of creamy white limestone, the entryway hints at quiet meditation and cool contemplation farther to the interior.  A double staircase, its steps centered between the three arches leading to the rest of the building, joins to itself in a landing rimmed with a golden baluster to the front.  Two wide, carved doors of white pine leading to the outside have been limned with golden paint to pick out the details.

title: [Western Corridor]
description: Limestone walls and columns support a barrel-vaulted roof of fossil-encrusted blocks.  Between the columns, glass-paned large windows line the western walls and provide a view of the well-manicured grounds, while woven reed prayer mats placed before marble-framed alcoves offer quiet places for contemplation.

description: Columns of aged limestone sparkle in the sunlight, while window between them provide views of the many grape arbors between the wings of the guild.  Tiles painted with feathers and crescent moons alternate with those of natural limestone on the floor, providing small rings of decoration around a pair of marble-framed alcoves.  Two small marble benches, each set on either side of a door, are topped with wide pillows that provide a quiet place for meditation.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: The passage is fairly wide here, and a chilly draft seems to be coming from the south, carrying a faintly acrid odor.  Further to the north, the roof of the passage is low enough to cause even the shorter races of Elanthia to stoop while travelling this route.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: Smoldering from atop a stone pedestal in the center of the room is an iron charcoal burner.  Drops of water sizzle fitfully as they land on the hot coals after a brief fall from the damp ceiling.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: None of the ground here is dry, and wooden slats have been strewn across it in a token attempt to keep people from sinking knee deep in the muck.  To the east is a muddy path leading inland and to the west is a raised plank walkway.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Western Walkway]
description: Thick cedar planks have been fastened horizontally on raised supports, granting reasonably safe egress above the dark black water.  Bulging hillocks of vegetation and algal mats give the illusion of solid ground in some spots below.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A large copper still is perched upon a stand of iron grating near a cleared and rock-lined fire circle.  Wooden buckets filled with rainwater have capped off spigots near their bases and rest on three flat, low-cut stumps nearby.  Coils of hammered copper tubing encircle the still's base and a stack of firewood awaits the next brewing.  Beyond the apparatus is a seedy-looking tavern, and to the east is an enormous ancient banyan.

description: Dim moonlight shines down, filtering through the shrivelled, broken stumps of limbs overhead.  Patches of shadow mingle and shift over small tracts of dying, diseased foliage that creep outward from the enormous blight-encroached banyan in vein-like tendrils.  Branches that once reached high into the sky now lay fallen and twisted among rotting heaps of debris at the base of the massive trunk, a startling contrast to the brightly colored flags that ring the diseased banyan.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Common Room]
description: Highly polished wood floors are covered with woven wool rugs, providing splashes of color in the large, chandelier-lit foyer.  A burled maple doorway resides in the eastern wall, and a sweeping grand staircase leads to the second floor.  In the opposite corner, a dimly lit hallway leads to the interior of the lodge.  Several burnished leather sofas and chairs, facing a low stone hearth, invite rest, while a a wide gold-chased table is placed between them.  Beside the entry doors a small golden depository sits against the darkly paneled wall.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Hallway]
description: Completely paneled in polished pine planking, the walls hold elaborate antler sconces.  Several doors lead off to the east, and the nearest one rests ajar, revealing shelves of linens and cleaning supplies.  A carved pine door leads to a dimly lit room, while a faint glow emanates from a curved mottled green doorway.  The granite floor is polished to a gleam, its mica flecks sparkling as the candles gutter and flare.

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Cord-like vines dangle across the cinnamon bark path that winds its way through the verdant jungle.  Tiny streamlets slip across the crimson-colored ground, their crystal clear waters tugging at the shaggy bark pieces in an unsuccessful attempt to draw them towards the larger body of water that can be heard but not seen.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Just inside the canopied green forest, it looks and feels like a completely different world compared to the open grassy foothills just a few steps away.  The foliage is so thick, the sky cannot be seen.

title: [Monkey Fist, Storage Closet]
description: Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

title: [Monkey Fist, Northeast Kitchen]
description: Neatly organized dishes rest upon steel-reinforced shelves, which stretch the length of the narrow, galley-style kitchen.  Copper lanterns provide ample illumination throughout the windowless space and a clever pulley-system attached to the ceiling rotates several palm fronds in slow circles.  One segment of the counter has been turned into a polished wood chopping block that has a pile of fresh garlic cloves and a large stoneware basin on it, while opposite stands an iron stove supporting a steaming pot.

title: [The Old Keep Road]
description: The road here has suffered the unmerciful wrath of nature over the years.  Recent travel has cleared a more narrow path through the center of the lane, but a great deal of foliage and weeds have flourished along both sides of the trail.  Off to the northwest, you see an expansive war-torn battlefield.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: The field is vast, stretching out for miles and miles of blemished and broken lands.  Patches of wild grass and thin saplings struggle up from the ground, trying to flourish in the ground once soaked in blood.

title: [The Murkwoods, Old Path]
description: Not far beyond the edge of the dense path, a clearing opens to reveal what appears to be a small cabin.  A decrepit fence surrounds the structure which, at first glance, seems abandoned.

title: [The Murkwoods, Cabin's Edge]
description: Faded and peeling, the aged fence surrounding the cabin is nearly toppling over, providing absolutely no deterrent for wandering travelers.  Thick wooden planks, secured with rusty nails, cover all visible windows, restricting view of the cabin's interior.  An old rune of dried blood is smeared above a sigil-etched wooden door.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden]
description: Greenery around a charming manor provides a backdrop for a colorful array of flowers taking shelter under a grove of assorted fruit trees.  Burbling brightly, a multi-tiered riverstone fountain is surrounded by three carved benches.  A path of round stones meanders up a small hill to the steps of a gazebo, then down to a stunningly azure pond.  The ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of vibrantly plumed peacocks struts amongst the verdure.

Moonbeams bounce off of a burbling stone a multi-tiered riverstone fountain surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the gazebo steps, then down to a dark azure pond.  Occupying the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal peacocks strut amongst the verdure, their colors eye-catching beneath the stars.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Entrance]
description: Pale stone steps lead up to an elegant riverstone manor, a woven doormat rests in front of a pair of stained glass doors.  An assortment of ceramic urns blooming with colorful flowers are placed about, the beautiful blossoms and greenery spilling over to blanket the steps.  Hanging to one side is a small brass bell, its polished surface shines brilliantly in the bright sunlight.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Ballroom]
description: Velvet-covered divans and settees rest comfortably against the white stucco walls, leaving the golden linden dance floor free of clutter.  Heavy draperies decorate the double archway that leads into the foyer, as well as the long expanse of a raised oak stage.  Frosted glass globes fitted with tiny candles dangle from the vaulted ceiling to lend the room soft illumination.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Foyer]
description: Oriel windows, graced with recessed seats, are framed in azure draperies of soft Vornavian silk that pools in placid folds upon the polished floors.  Climbing up to an open landing, an elegant stairway fixed with a decorative spindled railing looks over a pair of cozy linden chairs with a matching table between.  Resting in the center of the floor is a plush emerald green rug richly designed with the image of a peacock, while a blue silk banner hangs above stained glass doors.

title: [Mestanir, Temple Street]
description: Painstakingly constructed from tiny ceramic tiles and decoratively carved brick, the Temple of Koar boasts an impressive presence.  Meticulous care was given to the path directly facing the structure as well, the large cobblestones leading up to the temple replaced by a much smaller mosaic of colored tile.

title: [Mestanir, Dark Alley]
description: The narrow alley curves slightly, bordered by homes and buildings on each side.  The passage is dark, bathed in the shadow of the Temple of Koar nearby.

title: [Mestanir, Garden Lane]
description: A decorative stone wall surrounds the Temple of Koar, entrance granted within by a small postern gate.  A lush garden of ferns and wide-petaled flowers peeks out from just behind the wall, perhaps a place for quiet meditation or a morning stroll.

title: [Mestanir, Dark Alley]
description: The narrow alley curves slightly, bordered by homes and buildings on each side.  The passage is dark, bathed in the shadow of the Temple of Koar nearby.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Rotunda]
description: Capped with a rounded dome of stained glass, the smooth walls of crimson-veined alabaster are fitted seamlessly into place.  An intricate frieze adorns the rotunda between velvet-draped arches, each leading deeper into the consulate.  The floor is inlaid with concentric rings of heliodor surrounded by an eight-pointed star of despanal.  Hanging on the wall just to the side of the entrance is an an ebon plaque, its dark frame embellished with muted golden gilt.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Assemblage]
description: Covered with a rich, cinereal wool carpet, the marbled alabaster floor melds smoothly with the walls, veins of crimson contrasting with their immaculate surface.  A large ebon marble fireplace dominates the room, a basket of sticks resting at its base.  A number of small meeting tables are set along the perimeter, and a dark sideboard has been placed to the side, its surface covered with various bowls and platters.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Antechamber]
description: Striated with veins of crimson, the smooth alabaster walls are bare with the exception of the marbled coloring.  A rich, obsidian velvet carpet woven with golden whorls covers the floor.  The only furniture in the sparsely decorated antechamber is a pair of marble benches, placed to either side of a pewter-banded ebonwood door.

title: [Li'aerion, West Parlor]
description: A ceiling washed in deep blue and indigo is studded with sparkling diamonds of white, yellow, and pale blue.  Constellations form and scatter as the gems inexplicably shift positions, as though the domed ceiling were fluid rather than stone.  The gems reflect the light cast by the flames of white candles, clustered on a low silver oval table.  A large grey sheepskin rug is soft underfoot, dotted with some tasseled blue velvet pillows.  The walls are bare, save for a black silk tapestry on the eastern wall.

title: [Li'aerion, Kitchens]
description: Polished white stone countertops laden with copper cookware are fitted along three sides of this room.  A wide copper vent extends from the ceiling, ending above a large fire pit and roasting spit.  Above the counters are shelves neatly filled with silver and gold serving trays, tea sets, plates, and goblets.  The center of the fourth wall is occupied by a small oak door, flanked on either side by wooden hooks hung with heavy linen aprons.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountainside]
description: A few towering trees cling to life on this windy mountainside, standing apart from the dense forest to the east.  Snow flurries dance through the air and the ground is uneven, making every step precarious.

title: [Dragonspine, Alpine Forest]
description: A trail winds its way through the trees, but the incline is steep and the ground underfoot is slippery with frozen pine needles and loose rocks.  The branches rustle far overhead, continuously knocking clumps of snow to the ground.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: The staircase ends abruptly in a large, round room that is freezing cold.  Torches clamped to the walls burn with odd blue flames, highlighting rusty shackles that are attached to the rough walls.  One set of shackles still holds a pitiful skeleton covered in scraps of tattered cloth.  A pointed archway in the wall leads out.

title: [A Wide Tunnel]
description: The walls of this tunnel are smooth and lit by a series of rotting torches, each one burning with strange, thin golden flames.  The ground here is smooth, even, and free of debris.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Garden]
description: Secreted away amidst towering cedars and firs, this quaint garden has a simple, wild charm.  Decorative hedges line a moss-lined cobbled walk as it winds its way towards a short flight of steps that lead up to a white clapboard house.  On either side of the walkway, a quartet of evenly spaced raised planting beds teem with wildflowers.  Cutting through the grid of abundant color, a faint footpath leads to a side yard.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Side Yard]
description: Faint outlines of old raised planting beds, a neat pile of gardening tools, and tidy stacks of discarded placards hint at the former life of this space.  Now nothing but potted trees, hundreds lined up in methodical rows, grow in the expanse of this large yard.  Smaller cuttings and tiny tree starts cover the surface of a pitted worktable that rests up against the wall of the old farmhouse, between a plain wooden rack and a whitewashed split door.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Gnarled Roots]
description: Lit with splinters of illumination that spear down from the edges of the ceiling, the cavern is narrow and shaped like a tall cylinder.  Roots of every shape and size curl about the walls, completely covering them in a mass of brambles, the only area clear of them a natural stone arch that leads into luminescent space.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Glowing Pool]
description: Glowing with a pale, luminescent light, a large pool practically gleams in the dark area.  Rock walls hug the vicinity, the ceiling low and dripping with tiny drops of greenish water.  Streaks of a bronze-colored mineral zigzag from a naturally formed arch to a length of rope hanging from a series of spikes set into the walls.  An oddly twisted door handle is nailed into the floor.

title: [Ranger Guild, Oak Grove]
description: A cluster of ancient oaks forms a quiet glade, their heavy branches and foliage concealing anything above from view.  Several carved wooden benches are arranged on the mossy ground between the massive trees, set by the banks of a bubbling spring that emerges from a niche in the forest floor and flows between the roots.  A sturdy wooden pavilion opens to the south, half-covered by bushes and flowering vines, and a wide ladder leads up the gnarled trunk of the largest of the oaks.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
description: The pavilion is open to the elements on the north and east sides, its arched entryways half-covered by flowering bushes and vines that grow into the interior, spreading across the rough panelled walls and winding around the heavy ceiling beams.  Wooden tables and benches are arranged in semicircles in a central meeting area, and a bar and serving table can be glimpsed through a shaded niche in the south wall.

title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
description: A high wooden fence, half-hidden by vines and underbrush, curves around the south side of the glade.  The forest plants have been trimmed back, forming a wide clearing that seems to serve as a combination exercise yard and archery range, judging by the worn patches of ground and the well-used targets mounted on some of the oaks.  An arched entrance leads into an open wooden pavilion at the west side of the yard.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
description: Open on all sides to the mild breeze, this tent is large enough to shelter many.  Zephyrs tease the tassels of numerous cushions scattered on the intricately woven rugs which cover smoothly packed earth.  A lectern carved from a tree stump stands at one end of the pavilion, its surface polished to a mellow sheen and engraved with twining vines.  A path leads west to a garden.

title: [Ranger Guild, Garden Path]
description: Herbs grow in riotous profusion along the path and the only evidence of design is the orderly grouping of the plants by use.  The cool, clean scents of mint and lavender perfume the air, while dittany and borage grow in the shade of a nearby oak tree.  The murmur of running water comes from somewhere to the west.

title: [Underground Temple, Scintillant]
description: White marble torches affixed along the walls emit a radiant glow and direct focus toward the center of the room.  Stationed atop a tri-tiered platform, a large white opal, representative of the moon of Liabo, is nestled within a gold-threaded white velvet blanket.

title: [Underground Temple, Darkness]
description: Crumbling statues and a lack of sufficient lighting make travel through the temple challenging.  Overhead, an enormous sphere of polished grey moonstone, indicative of the moon of Lornon, hangs precariously on a single linked steel chain and spins erratically as currents of chilled air gust through this area of the temple.

In each corner, tables and chairs are grouped together beneath green-striped white canopy umbrellas.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Beach]
description: A circle of colorfully painted chairs surrounds a stone-lined fire pit just above the tide line on this white sand beach.  Elaborately constructed sand castles, towers, wagons and gers are displayed across the surface of the beach.  Colorful crustaceans of assorted size occasionally make their way around the driftwood and seaweed that has washed up on shore.  A blue modwir dock extends from the beach and out into the waves.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Dock]
description: Blue-painted lengths of modwir lumber are laid flat to form the surface of the dock.  Tall, rounded maoral posts line the dock, and a pair of large wrought-iron rings is bolted to the moorings.  A small rowboat is tied up to one of the wrought-iron rings and is surrounded by several whitewashed pedal boats.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, House Clerk]
description: Centered in front of a circular stained glass window, a high-backed leather chair rests behind a mahogany desk crowded with letters and empty teacups.  A sparrow trills inside a brass filigree cage prominently displayed atop a bookshelf, the leather-bound volumes within embossed with gold lettering on the spines.  Across from an arched opening, an illuminated globe of Elanthia casts a radiant blue light across the pale white marble floor.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Foyer]
description: Full-length windows fill the spaces between the pairs of stately pale white marble columns deeply veined with ebon that flank the oversized cherrywood double doors.  Across from the entry, an elaborately carved door sits off to one side of a wide staircase leading to a carpeted landing above, then further up and out of sight.  The sound of splashing water in a small marble fountain echoes across the foyer.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Antechamber]
description: Two pillars flank an arched hoarbeam door in the hall's formal entrance.  The side walls are adorned with portraits of august professors and headmasters, their attire formal, if antiquated.  Centered on the back wall, a large plaque in a gilded frame hangs with sconces on either side, the candlelight illuminating its elaborate script.  A westward corridor leads toward the classrooms.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Corridor]
description: Ornate sconces spaced evenly along the walls illuminate the elegant doors on either side of the corridor.  At the end, a jalousie-topped doorway has been bolted shut, closing off the passage from the rest of the building.

title: [Summit Academy, South Ellipse]
description: A current of warm air flows from the walkway that winds south beneath an arched canopy of trees.  As it mixes with the frosty air, a constant breeze swirls through the area.  A narrow flagstone path splits as it leads to both a tile-roofed manor house and a thatch-roofed cobblestone cottage.

title: [Summit Academy, Sylinar's Way]
description: The paved walkway winds its way between rows of trees, pleached to form an arched canopy over the path.  The air is unseasonably warm along the corridor, and to the south, the opening in the trees is filled with radiant sunlight.

title: [Feywrot, Forest Path]
description: Heading north from an ebon gate, a dirt path, as well as a bridge beyond, are barricaded with fallen trees.  Charred trunks of varying girths lay crisscrossed atop one another like matchsticks dropped from their box.  Evidence of fiery devastation blankets the surrounding swampland.  In the darkness, only a faintly discernable path, more like an animal trail, remains passable and leads off toward the east.

title: [Feywrot, Animal Trail]
description: Hoofprints, pawprints, and the smoothed-dirt striations from large dragging tails show the path taken by native inhabitants fleeing the scorched landscape of the former festival grounds.  The trail heads due east, past burnt vegetation and a few rotting carcasses, before opening up near the eastern walkway, partially submerged in the fetid, black waters of the swamp.

Each oozing ribbon of silt joins with the others where the slippery path levels out, forming a wet mire of boot-sucking sludge.  Choosing a safe foothold in the enveloping darkness becomes a trecherous task not suited to the faint-hearted.

A gnarled ebonwood quarterstaff is mounted perpendicular to the floor and has a simple blue flag draping from its length.

description: Bright firelight floods the area from no less than a dozen torches that hang from the rough oak walls in large wrought iron cages.  Scented rushes are thinly scattered across the floor and perfume the air with woodworm, hickory, and sage, the aroma nearly overpowering in the heat that falls off the surrounding walls in waves. title: [The Ophidian Cabal, Lounge]
description: Holding court amid both fresh and moldy rushes, a large throne-like chair fitted with a bright purple cushion sits at an angle to the room's far corner.  Smaller benches and stools pay homage to the monstrosity, which is gaudily decorated with copper asps.  Near to the entry, someone has taken a bench and nailed it to the top of another one to create a kind of high table where various drinks and food are displayed.

title: [Haunt of the Silent Investors]
description: Large cobblestone blocks, grey and slippery from years of water damage, form the walls of this circular section of sewer, their smooth faces interrupted by the placement of pipes and drains.  A long marble staircase follows the curve of the wall, providing egress for denizens, beneath which are pendant lanterns crafted of glowing witch-balls that are filled with bright white lights. title: [Cholen's Temple, Narthex]
description: Four slender columns stretch up from the marble floor of the round chamber, supporting a high domed ceiling. Colorful cushions and long divans are scattered about the room, some occupied by solitary musicians and small groups engaged in animated discussion.

description: The paved walkway winds its way between rows of trees, pleached to form an arched canopy over the path.  The air is unseasonably warm along the corridor, and to the south, the opening in the trees is filled with radiant sunlight.

title: [Roughened Path]
description: Forming a wall to the southeast, rows of trees protect the pathways of Summit Academy from the brisk breeze that filters in off the surrounding mountains.  Dark brown mud creates a thin track that leads away from the traditional grounds and marches in a northeasterly direction towards a city of brightly colored tents and painted wooden structures.  A wall of thuja hugs the northwestern edge of the muddy pathway, the tall trees sculpted to resemble horses rearing up.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The trees begin their gradual creep up the mountainside at this branch of the forest.  The path north is twisted and rocky, bending out of sight behind a wall of crooked, snow-laden spruces.  To the west, fresh paw prints mark a gently downhill sloping trail away from the mountain and deeper into the woods.

title: [Rumor Woods, Ascent]
description: The path up the mountain is gradual, the dense tree cover at both sides obscuring the scope of the ascent.  A gentle wind rattles the branches above, sending their ice-laden needles chattering against each other like teeth in the cold.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The path ends at a creek that seems to have stopped in time.  Its waters, though frozen solid, still echo their natural flows downstream.  A felled log offers access, however dubious, over the creek's frozen surface to its north bank.

title: [Rumor Woods]

description: Rich sapphire wool hangs from the white oak frame of this spacious pavilion.  A chandelier set with frosted globes hangs from the peaked ceiling, each orb etched with a blooming rose.  Soft ivory velvet drapes frame an archway that leads deeper into the shop, while matching wool carpeting underfoot muffles all sound.  A dark iron rack filled with elegant gowns is displayed in the center of the space.

title: [The Alabaster Rose, Salon]
description: Dark sapphire motes add color to the thick ivory wool carpet that cushions the floor.  To one side of the entrance is a small white oak table that holds a variety of refreshments.  A woven basket of sticks rests next to an ornate copper brazier placed centrally in the room.  A large sofa padded with dark blue cushions and a pair of chairs are placed in a circular pattern about the room.  Standing next to an etched vaalin-framed mirror is a dressing room door.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Broken stones amidst the fallen needles and snow banks herald the presence of an ancient stone roadway.  Remarkably intact despite its obvious age, it drives, arrow-straight, into the northern woodland.  The composite blocks of stone are unusually well-fitted.  Each is a sheer and unsullied white in color, the hue so intense as to make the abounding snow look drab.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: Underbrush and towering conifers alike seem unwilling to trespass onto the pale stone roadway.  The frost-laden wall of flora ends several paces from the pale stone walkway, but there is no sign that it has been cut back or cultivated in a way that would explain the stark delineation.  Unintelligible whispers play on the air, audible only in rare lulls of the screeching wind.

title: [Yander's Farm, Barn]
description: Dust motes float lazily in the air amid the redolent aroma of fresh hay in the barn's interior.  Heavy oak rafters high overhead span this large open area suitable for several gnomish threshing machines.  A newly painted baker's door stands open along the western wall, providing egress to the attached stables.

title: [Yander's Farm, Stables]
description: Several stalls line the outer wall of this small stable.  Stray bits of straw and scattered oats cover the hard-packed dirt floor, giving silent testament to the area's inhabitants.  A small metal pail sits quietly near a pitchfork, patiently awaiting use.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: A hallway winds through walls decorated with bas-relief carvings of a variety of instruments.  The floor is covered with large tiles, and a plush runner twists along the meandering curves, precisely following the twists and turns of the hall.  The rug matches the light-toned stucco walls, and a series of conch shell lanterns are suspended overhead.  An arch opens on the South Wall, revealing a pub beyond and admitting mouth-watering aromas and the distinctive clink of plate and mug.

title: [Bard Guild, Treblima's Trinkets]
description: Glaes-veined prismatic crystal chimes hang from the ceiling by thin silver chains, their rainbow-hued striations reflecting the steady light of a central lantern in a shifting, multihued display of colors across every surface in this quaint shop.  Lustrous songstones and jewelry are presented in a velvet-lined, tiered display case along the slightly curved wall, facing an arched passageway to the south.

title: [Ranger Guild, Den]
description: The den is an airy chamber, graced with wide expanses of openings created by the growing walls of the banyan tree.  Netting, so fine it is almost transparent, provides a covering to the natural windows, and small tree frogs cling to its exterior here and there like vivid green ornaments.  Against one wall, a small fire burns within a heavy pottery container, its smoke cleverly vented through a flue to the outside.

title: [Ranger Guild, Walkway]
description: A short hallway stretches from an arch at either end.  Its roof is peaked, created by a juncture of buttress roots.  The floor is finished with flagstones, the grouting between tinted a bright shade of green from moss growing there.  Along each side, the growing wood of the tree parts in places, providing views of the foliage outside, and birds have built nests here and there in handy crevices of the window openings.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: A veritable wall of thorns and greenery form a massive patch of bramble to the west.  Growths and sprouts creep up from the dirt and mud of the path and dislodge some of its few remaining stones.  Looming above and beyond the bramble is a thick canopy of trees and the forest they belong to.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Bramble]
description: The thick bramble surrounds and extends across the roughly cut path.  Thick, sharp thorns cover the branches and vines that lay in every direction.  Despite having been cut back, the bramble gives the impression of only being temporarily pushed back.

title: [House Aspis, Sun Room]
description: The two outside corner walls of this room are glass doors granting access to a small, private garden.  Moonlight gives the red oak flooring a blue shading.  Chimes of all sorts drop down from the ceiling, their music casting a hypnotic sensation on every breeze.  A large red oak tub, built into the floor, is filled to brimming with steamy water.  Fluffy, absorbent towels are stored in a rack within easy reach.

title: [House Aspis, Sun Room Garden]
description: Secluded from view from other areas of the House by a tall stone wall covered in leafy vines, this garden opens to the west to overlook the river.  Two cushioned lounge chairs with matching table between them face the water offering a shadowy view of the night sky reflecting off the surface of the water.

title: [Northern Woodlands, Trail's End]
description: The trail gradually comes to an end, the dirt path eventually giving way to thick foliage and thorny brambles.  Rising up like a great foreboding force, the outer edge of the Wyrdeep Forest stretches as far as the eye can see.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Edge]
description: The outer edge of the dense forest is blanketed in a welcoming array of lush green grass and colorful wildflowers.  Wide rows of ancient yew trees fashion a pronounced boundary as they sway to and fro, their twisted limbs stretching and beckoning, inviting passerbys into the forest's depths.

title: [Neartofar Road, Dam]

The southern edge of the grassy field highlights a bright thread of silvery stream held back into a small pond by a wide earthen dam that serves as a pathway across.

title: [Neartofar Road, Dam]
description: Wide enough to allow a wagon to pass, the dam's mounded dirt has been packed flat.  Old cobblestones peek from between weeds that have grown over the path. A small stone shop is tucked between a pair of spindly trees with warped bark that has been damaged by the sea air.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Clearing]
description: Sounds of the sea fill the clearing with the crashing tones of ocean waves.  As the trail winds around a tall stone circle, the way is covered with small pebbles, shells, and sand.  Caught behind the enclosing ring of granite, a towering lasimor tree spreads its branches upwards, its crimson leaves a beacon in the sky.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Glistening in the perpetual twilight, large cobblestone pavers stretch across the cramped streets from the edges of gabled buildings to the bowing bridge.  Lampposts wreathed in verdigris copper hold frosted globes aloft, the dim light spilling from them painting the area in a sheen of violet while doing nothing to dispel the shadows of a twining pathway.  Double doors provide entry to a thatch-roofed building, a wooden sign in wrought iron scrollwork above, that is connected to a smaller structure by a moss-covered lancet stone archway.

title: [Evermore Hollow, The Hotel]

description: Occupying the center of the boulevard, a two-story ebonwood building with a silver gypsum-inlaid door faces the canal where a lantern-lined cobblestone bridge spans the water, providing egress to and from a towering inn.  Narrow streets glittering with the perpetual dew and limned in violet hues from the everlasting twilight twist deeper into the sprawling town.  Trees dot the street within small expanses of grass, their limbs dappled with blue-green leaves and laden with fruit.

title: [Evermore Hollow, The Hotel]
description: Surrounded by verdant foliage, cobbled pavers, and wrought iron railings, the small island sits within the inky waters of a becalmed canal.  Ferrymen in gondolas offer passage off the island to parts unknown, while looping bridges lined in lanterns provide terrestrial access to the inner ring of Evermore Hollow.  Rising high into the twilight sky, a grand ebon-hued hotel is the focus of all nearby.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Innocent's End, The Explorers]
description: Leafy vines of bright green crawl across the rocky ground, their lengths entwining with the tall wooden treehouses flanking the dense foliage-covered road.  Iridescent-winged avians flit across the walkway, landing safely in the branches shading the path from the elements, the occasional call echoing from above.  The sweet scent of tropical fruits permeates the air, the sap-covered trees dotting the horizon.

title: [Innocent's End, Winding Trail]
description: Traversing the meandering trail proves tricky, trailing creepers and cat's-claw snatching at the clothing of passers-through as if to draw them into the verdant morass of vegetation.  A boscage of plant life girds the small road, constantly at odds with the foot traffic as it attempts to consume the ashlar paving stones disrupting its quest for hegemony.

title: [Both Sides Now, Central Room]
description: Divided in half symmetrically, the main room of the cottage is decorated in dark somber tones on one side and light cheerful hues on the other.  Display racks match in height and size, only their composition is different, creating a kind of opposing mirror visual.  The center has been left clear for customers to pause as they consider which half of the cottage to peruse first.  Stark torches flicker from their brackets on the shadow wall, opposed by clear, half-circle sconces glimmering parallel.

title: [Both Sides Now, Studio]
description: Disturbingly, this small alcove is a complete disparity from the main part of the cottage.  Skilled trompe-l'oeil has been applied to the walls, the rendering of clouds all around creating the despairing illusion of floating.  Fanciful designs of feathers drift here and there in hues of fuchsia, cerulean, and twilight.  Atop several clouds are playful circus scenes featuring striped tents and ferris wheels, flying pennants and strung with lanterns, but they are devoid of any customers.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Winter's Edge]
description: Barely visible behind large drifts of cold-hardened snow, a frozen lake glitters in the ambient light.  A large riverstone manor sits on a small rise, surrounded by several outbuildings, and the cobblestone path ends abruptly at a foreboding thicket of trees and briars.  Several twisting trails lead behind the manor to additional buildings.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Shadowed Copse]
description: Snowladen trees arch high above, casting shadows across the copse.  Several stone structures dot the depths of the woods, and several icy trails lead to additional buildings.  Icicle-fraught briars and brambles cluster together beneath the trees, the occasional frozen wild rose blossom adding a splash of color.

title: [Tippy Toes, Entry]
description: A richly carved mahogany carriage loaded with wooden trunks and wicker baskets is parked in the middle of the high-ceilinged foyer.  To the north, an archway separates the tack and equipment storage area from the living quarters beyond.  The fragrant scent of hay mingled with oiled leather hovers in the chill air.

title: [Tippy Toes, Living Quarters]
description: A pair of high-backed chairs separated by a low table huddle in front of a dark stone fireplace, the dying embers of a fire glowing within.  Along one grey-striped, papered wall sits a sturdy oaken sideboard with open drawers, its contents neat and orderly.  Tucked away beneath a narrow stairway, wooden bins full of colorful bits of fabric are nearly hidden from view.

title: [Don't Bug Me!, Showroom]
description: Beyond the irregularly edged fissure that marks the entrance to this torch-lit space, the striated rock walls open up to reveal a modestly sized cave lined with iron shelving.  Moisture glistens off the walls and floor, dancing with scintillating sparkles as the reflected torchlight moves sinuously with the fluctuating passage of incoming air.

title: [Don't Bug Me!, Workroom]
description: Though the seepage running down the striated rock walls glistens enticingly in the flickering light of an iron-framed torch, the accumulated puddles on the uneven floor make the footing quite hazardous.  A series of flat stone blocks provide seating around a small worktable covered with tools and metal shavings.

title: [Hall of Clans, Entry]
description: Row upon row of rune-carved columns march northward into the depths of this spacious hall.  White marble arches crisscross from column to column, creating a rib-vaulted ceiling overhead.  Polished hexagonal tiles fit neatly together spanning the floor throughout the solemn space.  Along the marble-finished southern wall, heavy iron sconces hold aloft lit torches that emit a soft golden light above a cobblestone arch that provides an exit back to Zul Logoth.  Visitors shuffle through with quiet reverence, pausing to inspect each column

title: [Short Tunnel]
description: This short tunnel is cramped and dark save for light illuminating the shapes of arched openings that appear at the northern and southern ends.  A hint of fungus mingles with the mineral scents of the cool, yet mildly humid, air.  Footsteps echo through the tunnel as the darkened silhouettes of dwarves pass from arch to arch.

title: [Titan's Deluge, East Bank]
description: Stretching over the water from the fall's west bank, a massive stone bridge seamlessly connects to a narrow strip of craggy rocks that broadens into a wider patch of land further down the lake shore.  Almost entirely unnoticeable, a series of crude steps carved into the mountain's face has been cleverly hidden behind a rough outcropping of stone near where the water spills over the edge and plummets below.

title: [Titan's Deluge, Bridge]
description: The view from the massive bridge connecting the waterfall's east bank to the west is unlike any other.  In one direction, the shadowy gaze of a soaring, imperious mountain denies light to the ridges, plateaus, and foothills below.  In the other, it hides a crater filled with the rain of countless storms and a ring of sky-grazing black columns on an island floating in a lake that reflects the always cloudy sky.

title: [Titan's Deluge, West Bank]
description: A massive stone bridge spans the crest of the waterfall, built from the same stone as the cliffs that soar around it.  Frequent bolts of lightning launched from the sky strike the water nearby, causing the formation of dense steam that floats and curls around the structure.

title: [Balmy Blooms]
description: Dusky golden sunlight pours in from an arched glass window that forms nearly the entire back wall of the divided alcove.  Blossoming wildflowers and feathered greenery are softly strewn through the entire space, a few of the wayward blooms gathered in small offerings around a slender blue quartz reliquary.  Grown over with intensely verdant mosses, an ivory sculpture of Imaera and Jaston sits at the center of the room, the opaque planes of their eyes perpetually gazing up towards the sky.

title: [Balmy Blooms, Nook]
description: The regressed nook is accented throughout with lush, jewel-toned flowers and vibrant green herbs.  A narrow grey stone bench wreathes around the perimeter of the room, highlighting a centrally placed woven silk tapestry of a sprawling elm tree with wide-arching branches.

title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
description: Whorling nets of shadowed silk funnel down into fathomless crevices and crannies in the wall of the cave, while others hang from the ceiling like tattered parodies of curtains.  Green-tinged luminescence burning in the hearts of the sticky strands serves as an uncertain and treacherous cynosure through the stygian passage.  Toward the end, the spidersilk grows dense and more radiant before culminating in a wall of webs.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Widow's Trap]
description: Swarms of tiny spiders with glistening incarnadine bodies scurry through the phosphorescent darkness.  The crude oil smell of thousands upon thousands of tiny spiders threads through the air, muting other scents just as the thick and faintly glowing webbing dangling from the ceiling muffles sounds.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Webwall]
description: A dense wall of inky webs occludes a sprawling mural limned across the face of the southwestern wall, but glints of sanguine enamel wink through like rubies.  Coruscating in the light of a dancing torch, the black bodies of multitudinous spiders skitter along the webs, engaged in tireless industry.  The sconce holding the torch is wrought of black alum and studded with red cabochon gems.

title: [Sylvisterai Camp, Perimeter]
description: Less than a trail and more than a path, a zig-zag meandering between bushes and through stands of trees branches the space between the Gyldemar Road and a glade of open meadow.  This liminal space, not quite in or out of two different worlds, is demarcated by a boundary of barricades.

title: [Sylvisterai Camp, Glade]
description: The bustle of the camp is in full swing here, in the midst of it all.  Paths wind off in a variety of directions, snaking their way between shelters and small domestic areas, artisans who've set out workshops, and guardposts, ever watchful and aware.  The bulkier forms of larger, more formal tents surround the glade like boughs on a tree, spaced at intervals behind an inner perimeter of wooden barricades.

title: [Tideswept Bazaar]
description: Bright corals in shades of crimson, gold, and violet cling to the walls and arching formations bringing the bazaar to life with their brilliant hues.  Schools of silvery fish weave about, their sleek bodies catching the shifting light that filters through the cavern.  Strands of kelp and drifting sea flora sway with the gentle currents, their rhythmic movements casting fluid shadows on the pathways.  Fringed with sea moss and glowing specks of bioluminescence, a narrow opening pulses with an ethereal glow.

title: [Silvershade Hollow]
description: Shallow currents weave through a glade where soft sediment gives way to swaying grasses and scattered coral shelves.  At the center rises a towering aelvara tree, its spiraled trunk lifting a canopy of glowing tendrils above the reef.  Light pulses through kelp-like strands in shifting blues and greens, echoing movements in the surrounding water.  Sea anemones cluster near the base, while darting fish and drifting plankton fill the space with constant, fluid motion.

title: [Tideswept Bazaar]
description: Winding through submerged rock, the coral tunnel is lined with spiny ridges and bulbous growths in muted hues.  Glowing sea plants cling to walls and ceiling, their soft radiance casting shifting patterns across the passage.  Schools of small, sleek swimmers dart between roots and crevices, flashing silver and blue.  At the far end, a narrow opening filters light from beyond, illuminating suspended particles and outlining the silhouettes of marine life as they vanish into deeper water.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Kapok trees rise overhead, a dense canopy spreading out from the thick, sturdy trunks.  A wrought iron gate, thickly overgrown with climbing roses, marks the start of a stone-lined walkway.  Curving through clusters of plumeria and orchids, a pale path of seashells joins a sandy path that winds downward toward a wooden dock.  Ferns and philodendrons press along the edges, their greenery filling the spaces between the blossoming growth.

title: [Drunken D'Wharf]
description: Reaching out from the shoreline, a long pier stretches over the gentle waves, its wooden posts, darkened by years of salt and spray, rise from the water, bound together with thick ropes and iron bands.  Moored to the weathered pier, a two-masted brigantine looms tall against the horizon.  A grumpy dwarven sailor stands close by, his watchful gaze intent and alert.  Near the water's edge and nestled among some dwarf fruit trees, a solitary weathered bench offers an expansive view of the bay.

description: This chamber appears to be relatively new.  The walls have been roughly carved from the surrounding grey rock in a simple manner with no finishing touches having been added anywhere in sight.  The dull roar of rushing water emanates from the south and water clings to the surface of the walls, making them glisten with moisture.  You also see a rusted metal gate.

title: [Dungeon, Waterfall]
description: This natural limestone cave was created by an underground spring.  The southern wall is covered by a giant sheet of water which cascades from a channel high above, pouring down through a wide fissure.  The waterfall pounds down onto the rocks below, as noisy as it is beautiful.  A manmade passage leads back to the north.

title: [Tempest Queen, Smoking Lounge]
description: Reserved for gentlemen, the richly appointed lounge smells of fragrant tobacco.  Opposite a gilded arch, a pair of brass-buttoned dark leather couches faces each other across a low ivory-inlaid table.  A felt-topped gaming table is arranged with a quartet of high-backed chairs, a trolley nearby stocked with playing cards and white jade dice.

title: [Tempest Queen, Second Deck]
description: Plush carpet runners muffle the sounds of constant foot traffic between the lounges and entertainments on this level and the main deck below.  Tucked into dimly lit alcoves along the hallway, velvet-cushioned settees invite respite and casual conversation.  On the starboard side, a gilded plaque is mounted on a burnished mahogany door.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Scattered clouds briefly obscure the sun, casting gentle shadows over cottages built along the pond's bank.  Between the cottages, ceramic statues of anthropomorphic mushrooms, painted in the vibrant red-and-white pattern of fly amanita, hold steel-wrought dandelion cypselae, some frozen in mid-flight.  Ripples in the pond weave around broad lily pads, each set with a small, unlit votive.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia, Island]
description: Secluded from the emporia by reed canary grass at the edge of a wide pond, a small island garden forms a quiet oasis.  Centered within it, an alabaster marble fountain is encircled by four stone benches, while broad patches of wildflowers lend vibrancy throughout the space.  A circular building wrought from exposed timber beams and irregular stones rises just beyond the garden's heart, its solid construction marking a functional presence among the serene surroundings.
